name: Primordial Strength: Growing Ferocity
description:
**Subclass Feature**

Ferocity 2: Whenever you use the Knockback maneuver, the forced movement distance gains a +2 bonus. Ferocity 4: The first time you push a creature on a turn, you gain 1 surge. Ferocity 6: You gain an edge on Might tests and the Knockback maneuver.
